raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 (all 378 UTC-tagged rows) was delivered with txn_ts in UTC, while every earlier batch is in America/Chicago local time. The pipeline ignores source_tz, so late-evening Jan 18 Chicago transactions spill into 2026-01-19 00:00-06:00, and every batch-14 timestamp is 6 hours ahead (CST is UTC-6 in January). Converting the UTC rows to Chicago local time fixes this: batch 14 then starts at about 06:03, matching the other batches, and ends at 2026-01-18 22:56.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
